# Create a function to read and reaarange each csv file

```{r}
read_gene <- function (file) {
  data <- read_csv(
    file,
    col_names = FALSE,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  # Check if the file has 2 columns with values
  if (ncol(data) == 2 && any(!is.na(data$X2)& data$X2 !="")) {
  
  #convert rows into columns 
    wide_data <-data |> 
      filter(!is.na(X1), X1!= "") |> 
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = X1,
        values_from = X2
      )
    # Identify missing variable values 
    missing <- data |> 
      filter(is.na(X2) | X2 == "") |> 
      pull(X1)
    
    # Add file name and processing status 
    wide_data |> 
      mutate(
        file_name = basename(file),
        file_status = ifelse(
          length(missing) == 0,
          "complete",
          "incomplete_values"
        ),
        missing_fields = paste(missing, collapse = "; ")
      )
    
  } else {
    # Record files that contain no usable values 
    tibble(
      file_name = basename(file),
      file_status = "missing_values",
      missing_fields = paste(data$X1, collapse = "; ")
    )
    
  }
}
  
```

# test the first and second csv

# then apply function to all csv files

```{r}
test_function <- read_gene(csv_files[1]) 
View(test_function)

test_function2 <- read_gene(csv_files[2])
View(test_function2)

file_results <- map(csv_files, read_gene, .progress = TRUE)
```

# Combine the dataset into one

```{r}
combined_data <- bind_rows(file_results)
dim(combined_data)
str(combined_data)

# count files by processing status 
table(combined_data$file_status)

# identify files with missing values 
incomplete_files <- combined_data |> 
  filter(file_status != "complete")

View(incomplete_files)

# Delete the last three rows in the incomplete files 
incomplete_files <- incomplete_files[, 1:(ncol(incomplete_files) - 3)]

# check the number of files processed 
nrow(combined_data) 
ncol(combined_data)
view(combined_data)

# Delete the last 3 NA rows in the combined data 
combined_data <- combined_data[, 1:(ncol(combined_data) - 3)]

```

# save the combined dataset

```{r}
write_csv(
  combined_data,
   "C:/Users/jadeo/OneDrive/Documents/combined_gene_data.csv"
)
```
